body: Jelani S013 claims the prompt package split (owner directive 2026-11-01: 'make it a package like prompt/ so we split files — organized, maintainable, expandable'): restructure the S012 prompt-structure work (flat prompts.py 1518 lines + prompt_structure.py + rules_library.py) into the core/agent/prompt/ package — engine (structure.py), section-name contract (names.py), shared rules (rules.py), per-surface section families (sections/parent.py, chat.py, agent.py, personas.py, turn.py), later-call staging (staging.py), surface dispatch (system.py) and the planner + handoff-pipeline builders — every import site updated, flat modules retired, zero behavior change (byte-identical renders).
